scientific_target.question: Can a bounded investigation correctly estimate and interpret all prespecified sustained-versus-transient category-information contrasts on the fixed COGITATE experiment1 MEG panel, retaining duration/offset and task-relevance alternatives?
scientific_target.known_answer: The independently recomputed orientation-balanced accuracy cells and signed temporal contrasts under one fixed crossvalidated estimator. A positive sustained-content effect is not a known answer.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Measured MEG and observed face/object, duration, relevance and orientation labels enter the analysis; the independent reference generates estimator-specific numerical answers. Interpretation requires estimator scope and support, not endorsement of a consciousness theory.
scientific_target.case_unit: Complete33-participant analysis with42accuracy cells and24contrasts per participant; cells are report entries, not independent cases.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Participant in one selected SA-prefix phase3/V1 duration-task cohort; trial/image repetitions and overlapping training fits are dependent.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Fixed-cohort sensor-space temporal analysis with labeled observations. It is neither NEURAL-097 hidden-category prediction nor reproduction of source-space ROI/pseudotrial generalization matrices.
exclusions: A numerical reconstruction score as evidence for no-tools/native neural understanding.
Low decodability as absent content or any whole consciousness-theory verdict.
SD/sqrt33 as a calibrated confidence interval despite overlapping training and multiple contrasts.

Six fixed good magnetometers in original author epochs; no additional filtering/smoothing/resampling. Baseline[-0.5,-0.3)s; six-sensor means over fixed200-ms pre/onset/middle/late/post windows.
Task instructions and helper schemas inA; same observations plus original author-source evidence inB.

observation_contract.case_identity: Participant keys come from the exact external COHORT.json; all42cell and24contrast keys are fixed by public/protocol.py. Actual complete admitted observation inventory remains unavailable in the public source projection.
observation_contract.split: For each held participant×image half, train only1500-ms trials of the other32participants and opposite image identities; all repetitions/orientations of an image stay together. Each query is used once across image halves. This internal analysis split does not hide the observed labels from the investigator.
observation_contract.coverage: 33people,66outerfolds, five training windows/330fits,1386accuracy cells and792contrasts; every relevance/duration/orientation support cell must exist. A/B andF/I conditions are within this one task. Central runtime remains source_only_inactive.

primary.name: Equal-participant mean absolute accuracy-cell reconstruction error (calibration endpoint)
primary.aggregation: Average absolute error over42fixed cells within participant, then equally across33participants.
primary.rationale: This is what the delivered score.py implements. It measures faithful execution of the declared analysis, not scientific insight; an understanding claim additionally requires independently scored supported interpretations, which this artifact-only scorer does not establish.

secondary: Equal-participant mean absolute signed-contrast reconstruction error across24contrasts.
All24 signed means and participant SD/descriptive SE reported without significance selection.
Proposed interpretation endpoint: correct estimator/offset/relevance/support claims against independently computed evidence; current numeric scorer does not grade these claims.

comparators.name: Independent fixed logistic-analysis reference
comparators.inputs: Same labeled six-sensor observations, physically separated training participant/images.
comparators.procedure: Declared LogisticRegression(C=1,liblinear,tol=1e-8,max_iter=2000,random_state=98098); training-only scaling and participant×class×relevance×orientation weights; diagonal and onset-transfer predictions. Convergence failure withholds construction.

comparators.name: Pre-stimulus and offset-matched temporal comparisons
comparators.inputs: Prespecified pre/onset/middle/late/post windows on the identical eligible panel.
comparators.procedure: Retain fixed difference-in-differences for500vs1500ms middle and1000vs1500ms late, plus late−onset and post−late contrasts; no favorable sign selection or automatic baseline subtraction.

nuisance_controls: Remove recorded response/button trials over the full stated interval; verify actual stimulus offset within1.01raw samples and no subsequent-stimulus intrusion.
Keep structural NaNs for nonexistent short/medium late windows; do not turn them into classifier features.
Distinguish diagonal decodability from onset-to-later transfer; retain duration and relevance interactions.
Report source preprocessing/ICA/filter history and the risk of retrospective motor or temporal leakage.
evaluation.uncertainty: Participant SD and SD/sqrt33 are descriptive only. All24contrasts remain visible; calibrated inference and multiple-comparison treatment require separate empirical qualification. No fixed effect direction is rewarded.
evaluation.failure_policy: All33participants,42cells and24contrasts required; finite bounded cells and derived contrasts must agree within1e-12. Validate entire report before reference access. Missing support makes the fixed panel unavailable rather than silently reducing the cohort.
